title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
description:
Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable

Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.

About the Team

The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.

You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.

The Challenge

Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:

  • Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.
  • Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.
  • Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.
  • Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.
  • Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.
  • Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.

Your Role

As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.

Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.
  • Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.
  • Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.
  • Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.
  • Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.
  • Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.
  • Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.

Who Are You?

  • First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.
  • You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.
  • You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.
  • You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.
  • You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.
  • You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).
  • Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.
